name: Question 15
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -2 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}],\,D=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices given above.
Find an orthogonal matrix $P$ such that $x=Py$ defines the corresponding change of variables that reduces the quadratic form $Q(x)={x}^{T}\,Ax$ to the canonical (diagonal) form ${y}^{T}\,Dy.$
